lines: By goddesses in one swift instant difference melts; thought lives and shines, the mothers stand. Enough.
Weighed in my heart, formed of stillness, be gracious: maker of death and endings, blessed one.
sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ devībhiḥ sapadi dalite bhedavibhave | mṛtyupralayakaraṇī me bhagavatī
